A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LLaVA-ST. The original 12 pages are unchanged apart from the arXiv version/date stamp; v2 adds eight pages of supplementary material. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 2–8, including spatial-temporal grounding, referring expression comprehension, and video question answering.

after.justification: v2 retains those empirical results and adds training-stage and packer-branch ablations in Tables 9–10, plus qualitative model outputs.

M1.justification: The architecture, LAPE, STP, and three-stage training procedure in Sections 3–4 are unchanged. Section 7 and Figure 4 disclose MLP and residual-connection details within the existing packer, without documenting a revised method.

E1.justification: The training sources and task coverage are retained. New ablations reuse RefCOCO, ST-Align, and Charades-STA; the qualitative examples illustrate grounding, captioning, and conversation tasks already represented in Table 1.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in Tables 2–6 is unchanged. Section 11 explains the existing GroundingGPT adaptation and ELC prompts for Grounded-VideoLLM and VTimeLLM; it introduces no additional benchmark comparator.

E3.justification: New supplementary experiments compare stage removal/mixing using 25% of the training data and packer-branch removal using 50% of fine-grained training data. Table 10 adjusts output resolutions, producing token budgets of 2025, 2500, and 2520. Existing experiment settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Beyond v1's whole-module and training-data ablations, Tables 9–10 directly test separate coordinate-alignment training and the necessity of each STP stream. Figures 7–15 also add extensive qualitative cases covering localization, captioning, and multi-turn dialogue. This substantially expands the diagnostic evidence.

E5.justification: Neither version reports seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The new ablation tables continue the existing point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Tables 2–8 retain their numerical results. Table 9 adds STVG msIoU values of 16.6, 18.3, and 21.2 for omitted, mixed, and separate Stage 2 training. Table 10 adds single-branch results while repeating Table 7's full-model baseline. Figures 7–15 add qualitative outputs; these are supplemental findings, not revised main-model performance.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 and the mathematical method definitions are unchanged. Section 10 explains the existing IoU metrics and averaging conventions; it adds no new theorem, proof, derivation, or substantive mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion are unchanged. Claims concerning unified spatial-temporal understanding, LAPE, STP, ST-Align, progressive training, and benchmark performance retain their original scope.

C2.justification: Section 8 adds interpretations that separating coordinate alignment particularly benefits spatial localization in videos, and that temporal resolution also supports distinguishing objects across frames. These refine the mechanism discussion beyond v1's whole-module and training-data interpretations. No substantive limitations discussion is added.

D1.justification: Sections 7 and 9–11 substantially expand reproducibility information: packer internals, 350K-image GranD sampling, MUSE mask-to-box conversion and filtering, instruction templates, metric aggregation, and baseline inference procedures and prompts. Existing hardware, main hyperparameters, and the promised code/data release remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work sections and bibliography are identical. Supplementary discussions cite already included works and retain the existing research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds a separately headed supplement organized into Sections 7–12 with explanatory prose. The original paper's wording and section order remain intact, so the narrative change is a localized extension.

P2.justification: The supplement substantially expands visual presentation through a packer diagram, boxed prompt templates, illustrated grounding and dialogue outputs, and two ablation tables. Figures 4–15 communicate implementation and model behavior absent from v1's displays. Existing figures, tables, and main-page layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 strengthens support for stage separation and the two STP streams, which v1's ablations did not isolate, and makes data construction, scoring, and baseline adaptations easier to reproduce. These are useful, targeted gains. The additional validation uses reduced training subsets and illustrative cases, while the principal benchmark evidence and core claims remain unchanged.
